privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How {company} collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how {company} (the “Operator”, “we”, “us”) collects, uses, stores, and shares personal data of users of the Service. We process personal data in accordance with the Law of the {country} “On Personal Data and Its Protection” No. 94-V dated 21 May 2013 (the “Personal Data Law”) and other applicable legislation.

s1.p: The data controller (Operator) is {company}, contactable at <mail>{email}</mail>.

s2.li1: Account data. Provided by your authentication provider (typically Google): email address, display name, profile picture URL, and a stable user identifier.
s2.li2: Profile data. Runner profile claim information (full name, city, country) submitted by you, and verification evidence you choose to provide.
s2.li3: Strava data. If you connect Strava: athlete ID, OAuth tokens, and activity metadata (distance, pace, dates) used for training analytics.
s2.li4: AI Coach uploads. Video files you upload, extracted frames, and AI-generated analysis output.
s2.li5: Transaction data. Record of Coin balance, awards, debits, and purchases.
s2.li6: Technical data. IP address, browser user agent, device type, access logs, and similar diagnostic information.

s3.p: The Service also displays running event results that are publicly published by event organisers on their official websites. These results (name, city, finish time, place, etc.) are aggregated for informational purposes. If you wish to be excluded, contact us at {email} and we will remove your record within a reasonable period.

s4.h: 4. Purposes of Processing and Legal Basis
s4.li1: to create and operate your account; basis: performance of a contract (Article 9 of the Personal Data Law);
s4.li2: to verify runner profile claims and email you the outcome of your claim; basis: your consent;
s4.li3: to provide training analytics from Strava; basis: your consent and contract;
s4.li4: to deliver AI Coach analysis; basis: performance of a contract and your consent to processing of uploaded video;
s4.li5: to process Coin purchases and prevent fraud; basis: performance of a contract and legitimate interests;
s4.li6: to comply with legal obligations; basis: statutory requirements.

s5.p: By creating an account and using the Service, you provide consent to the collection and processing of your personal data for the purposes described above. You may withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account or by contacting {email}. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing performed prior to withdrawal.

s6.p1: We share personal data only with:
s6.li1: Sub-processors acting on our instructions, including: Supabase (database and storage), Vercel (hosting), Google (authentication), Strava (training data integration), Resend (transactional email, such as claim decisions), and AI model providers used by AI Coach for inference.
s6.li2: Payment processors when you purchase Coins. We do not store full payment card numbers on our servers.
s6.li3: Authorities when required by law, court order, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Operator or others.
s6.p2: Some sub-processors may process data outside the {country}. Where such cross-border transfer occurs, we ensure adequate protection in accordance with Article 16 of the Personal Data Law.

s7.p: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. AI Coach video files and extracted frames are retained while the session is visible in your account and may be deleted at your request.

s8.p1: Subject to the Personal Data Law, you have the right to:
s8.li1: access the personal data we hold about you;
s8.li2: request rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data;
s8.li3: request blocking or destruction of your data;
s8.li4: withdraw consent and request deletion of your account;
s8.li5: lodge a complaint with the authorised body for personal data protection of the {country}.
s8.p2: To exercise these rights, contact us at <mail>{email}</mail>. We will respond within the period prescribed by applicable law.

s9.p: We apply organisational and technical measures appropriate to the risks of processing, including encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS), access control, server-side handling of secrets, and least-privilege database policies. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s10.p: The Service uses strictly necessary cookies for authentication session management and preferences (e.g. theme and language). We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies for behavioural advertising.

s11.p: The Service is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

s12.p: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Effective date” above reflects the latest revision.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: Refund terms for Coin purchases on {company}.
refund.intro: This Refund Policy applies to purchases of virtual coins (“Coins”) made on {company} (the “Service”). It is issued in accordance with the Law of the {country} “On Protection of Consumer Rights” No. 274-IV dated 4 May 2010.

s1.p: Coins are a non-monetary in-service currency used to unlock paid features such as AI Coach analyses. Coins have no real-world cash value, are non-transferable between accounts, and cannot be exchanged for cash or any other consideration except as expressly stated in this Policy.

s2.p: You may request a refund of a Coin purchase in the following cases:
s2.li1: Cooling-off period. Within fourteen (14) calendar days of purchase, provided that none of the purchased Coins have been spent. Once any portion of a Coin pack has been consumed within the Service, the pack is considered “used” and is no longer refundable, as the digital good has been delivered and consumed.
s2.li2: Technical fault. Coins were debited from your account but the paid feature failed to deliver due to a defect attributable to us (e.g. AI Coach analysis permanently failed to produce results). In such cases we will, at our discretion, either re-credit the spent Coins or refund their monetary value.
s2.li3: Duplicate charge. You were charged more than once for the same purchase due to a payment processor error.
s2.li4: Unauthorised charge. The purchase was made without your authorisation, subject to investigation.

s3.p: Refunds are not available in the following cases:
s3.li1: Coins that have been fully or partially consumed within the Service;
s3.li2: change of mind after consumption of the digital service;
s3.li3: dissatisfaction with AI Coach output where the analysis was technically delivered;
s3.li4: account termination due to breach of our <terms>Terms of Service</terms>;
s3.li5: requests made more than 14 days after purchase, except where mandatory law provides otherwise.

s4.p: Send an email to <mail>{email}</mail> from the email address associated with your account, including:
s4.li1: your account email and approximate date of purchase;
s4.li2: the payment receipt or transaction identifier;
s4.li3: a brief explanation of the reason for the refund request.

s5.p: We aim to respond to refund requests within seven (7) business days. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method. Settlement may take an additional 5–14 business days depending on your bank or card issuer. Refunds are issued in Kazakhstani Tenge (KZT, ₸) at the original transaction amount; any currency conversion or bank commissions on your side are not within our control.

s6.p: Before initiating a chargeback with your bank or card issuer, we kindly ask that you contact us first so we can resolve the matter directly. Filing a chargeback without first contacting us may delay resolution and may result in suspension of your account pending investigation.

s7.p: This Policy does not limit any mandatory rights granted to you as a consumer under the legislation of the {country}. In case of any conflict between this Policy and mandatory consumer protection law, the latter prevails.
